messages.text: Is there only the shipping cost on top of the $1,100?

Shipping, plus tax depending on where it lands. US and Canada: no import VAT, just sales tax where it applies. EU or UK: 21% VAT (UK, their rate) and any duty are charged on delivery by the carrier, not at checkout.

Where would it ship to?

For Austria: $1,100 plus shipping, plus 21% import VAT and any duty charged on delivery by the carrier — we don't collect that at checkout, and I can't quote the exact customs figure. Shipping is a flat worldwide rate by weight, shown at checkout from your address.

One thing worth knowing: no PunkHash units are released for sale right now — the window is Q4 2026 from the supplier. If you want something you can order today, the Magic Miner 40T at $799 is our best value per terahash, ships November 21, 2026.

Which matters more to you, the 70 TH in one box or getting running sooner?
